subject.title: perf: bound publisher profile, membership, and catalog reads

question: Should getPublishedDisplayManifest return only bounded manifest metadata and delegate resources to the existing paginated catalog, become independently paginated, or intentionally return a documented capped subset?
rationale: Each option changes the profile and catalog contract differently, and neither the issue nor the merged partial implementation establishes one mechanically correct permanent behavior.

options.title: Split metadata and catalog
options.body: Keep the manifest query bounded to source metadata and load resources through the existing kind-specific paginated catalog query.

options.title: Paginate the manifest
options.body: Add an explicit kind and cursor contract so callers can retrieve the full manifest-backed catalog over bounded requests.

options.title: Cap the response
options.body: Preserve one response while enforcing and documenting a fixed maximum, accepting intentional truncation for large publishers.

recommendation.title: Split metadata and catalog
recommendation.body: Keep the manifest query bounded to source metadata and load resources through the existing kind-specific paginated catalog query.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the audit and partial implementation history and identified this exact unresolved contract.
